description_good_justification: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/README.md says what it does: a Language Server Protocol server for the OpenSIPS routing script language (opensips.cfg), with a table of every feature.
interact_justification: How to obtain it: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md and the releases at https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/releases . How to report bugs, ask for features and contribute: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs .
contribution_justification: Changes come as GitHub pull requests from a feature branch, one problem per pull request: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires a failing test first for every behavior change, the Google Rust Style Guide (rustfmt through scripts/fmt.sh, the clippy lints in Cargo.toml and tests/style_test.rs), clippy with -D warnings, rustdoc with -D warnings, and evidence from the OpenSIPS grammar or binary for any claim about the language.
floss_license_justification: MIT OR Apache-2.0, at the user's option: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/LICENSE-MIT and https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/LICENSE-APACHE .
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT and Apache-2.0 are both OSI-approved.
license_location_justification: LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT in the repository root, and the same texts named by SPDX identifier in https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/tree/main/LICENSES (REUSE layout).
documentation_basics_justification: Install and use: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md . Secure use: the Security note and Data handling sections of https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/README.md and the Security section of https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/ADMIN.md .
documentation_interface_justification: Every feature and setting: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md . Every option: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/ADMIN.md . Editor setup and the opensips-lsp check command line: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/docs/EDITORS.md . The server speaks the standard Language Server Protocol over stdin and stdout.
sites_https_justification: The project site is the GitHub repository, https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp , served over HTTPS; the extension is published on https://open-vsx.org .
discussion_justification: GitHub issues, pull requests and discussions: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/issues and https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/discussions . They are searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone with a GitHub account and need no proprietary client.
english_justification: The documentation, the code comments and the issue tracker are in English; https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs asks for issues in English.
maintained_justification: Under active development, with releases every few days: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/commits/main and https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/releases
repo_track_justification: Git records each change, its author and its date.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is committed to main, not only releases: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/commits/main
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number. The release workflow refuses a v* tag that differs from the Cargo.toml version, the client/package.json version or the newest client/CHANGELOG.md entry: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
version_semver_justification: Versions are MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: new features raise the minor version and releases with only fixes or dependency updates raise the patch version, as 0.26.3 (dependency update) and 0.27.0 (features) in https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/client/CHANGELOG.md show.
version_tags_justification: Each release has a v* git tag, 54 so far, and the release workflow publishes only from a pushed v* tag: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/tags
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/client/CHANGELOG.md is a human-readable summary of each release, not a git log; the release workflow refuses a release without its entry.
release_notes_vulns_justification: The 0.24.6 entry of https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/client/CHANGELOG.md names the three advisories it fixed in the bundled brace-expansion package: GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 and GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr. No vulnerability in opensips-lsp itself has been reported.
report_process_justification: Bugs and feature requests are GitHub issues, opened with the forms at https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/issues/new/choose , as https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs describes.
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been submitted by anyone other than the maintainer since the repository was created on 2026-08-19: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request has been submitted by anyone other than the maintainer since the repository was created on 2026-08-19: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is on for the repository, as https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/SECURITY.md says: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/security/advisories
build_justification: cargo build --release builds the server, npm ci and npm run compile build the VS Code client, and tree-sitter generate builds the grammar: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/README.md#build--test
build_common_tools_justification: Cargo, npm and the tree-sitter CLI, the standard tools for Rust, TypeScript and tree-sitter grammars.
build_floss_tools_justification: The build needs only FLOSS tools: Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, TypeScript, the tree-sitter CLI and a C compiler.
test_justification: cargo test, documented in https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/README.md#build--test , runs unit, end-to-end and proof tests against a real OpenSIPS 4.0.2 tree and binary in CI on every push and pull request; npm test checks the client: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_invocation_justification: cargo test and npm test, the standard invocations for Rust and npm.
test_most_justification: Measured with cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1 over cargo test --all-targets, with the proof tests running against the real binary, on the tree of commit https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/commit/2cdb93c25b20e66c73e7d96f89326642a309dcc3 plus these answers: 71.0% of lines, 70.2% of functions and 73.0% of regions of the Rust server. CI does not measure coverage.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs fmt, clippy, the tests, rustdoc, the client tests, the grammar tests, cargo audit and the MSRV build on every push to main and every pull request: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: every behavior change lands test-first, and parsing code must also cover adversarial input.
tests_are_added_justification: For example, the change that added include-path completion added 150 lines of tests with it: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/commit/b8bbc1fdcac1728c7b36dfd43d60fbb1c17f37ba
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: pull requests that add behavior without new tests will be asked to add them.
warnings_justification: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check and rustdoc with -D warnings run in CI; the TypeScript client compiles with strict on: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/client/tsconfig.json
warnings_fixed_justification: -D warnings makes every rustc, clippy and rustdoc warning an error, so a change with a warning fails CI; main builds with none: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain
warnings_strict_justification: Every rustc and clippy warning is an error on every target, including the tests; missing_docs is deny (https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/src/lib.rs); TypeScript strict mode.
crypto_published_justification: opensips-lsp uses no cryptography: it reads files, runs the opensips binary and speaks JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout. No cryptographic crate is in https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/Cargo.lock .
crypto_keylength_justification: opensips-lsp uses no cryptography and holds no keys.
crypto_pfs_justification: opensips-lsp opens no network connection, so it has no key agreement.
crypto_password_storage_justification: opensips-lsp stores no passwords and has no users.
crypto_random_justification: opensips-lsp makes no keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: The source, the release files and the install scripts come from GitHub over HTTPS (or git over SSH), and the extension from Open VSX over HTTPS: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/install.sh
delivery_unsigned_justification: Nothing is fetched over HTTP, and no hash is retrieved over HTTP: the install scripts and the workflows use HTTPS URLs only.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There is no open vulnerability: no security advisory, no open Dependabot alert, and cargo audit --deny warnings passes in CI. The last ones, three advisories in the bundled brace-expansion package published on 2026-09-29, were fixed in 0.24.6, released on 2026-10-02.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: The two high-severity brace-expansion advisories, published on 2026-09-29, were fixed in 0.24.6, released on 2026-10-02. https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/SECURITY.md sets 30 days as the target for a critical fix.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No private key, password or token is committed. GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on and have no alerts; the release workflow reads its Open VSX token from a repository secret.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript and GitHub Actions) on every push, every pull request and weekly: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml . Clippy runs in every CI run.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security queries look for common vulnerabilities such as command injection, path traversal and workflow injection.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and pull request and weekly; clippy runs in every CI run: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer run over the tree-sitter grammar's C on every push and pull request, before any release: the grammar-sanitizers CI job (https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/blob/main/scripts/grammar-sanitize.sh) runs the corpus tests and parses every .cfg in the OpenSIPS trees and the fixtures through a sanitized build (https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/actions/runs/40480375554/job/122108875971). The Rust server is not under a dynamic analysis tool.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The grammar's C, the hand-written scanner.c and the generated parser.c, is built with -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer and runs the corpus tests and a parse of 125 shipped and fixture .cfg files on every push, failing on any report; the job first proves it fails by planting a one-byte out-of-bounds read and a signed overflow in a copy of scanner.c: https://github.com/NormB/opensips-lsp/actions/runs/40480375554/job/122108875971 . The Rust server has no unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: cargo test builds the dev profile, with debug assertions and integer-overflow checks on; Cargo.toml sets no profile that turns them off.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer job has reported nothing in the grammar, so no finding is left to fix.
